title: Communication Error
cause: Malfunction of transmission between indoor and outdoor unit
solution: Check transmission wiring and thermistor.

title: Room Temperature Sensor Fault
cause: Open or short circuit in room temperature sensor
solution: Replace the room temperature sensor.

title: Pipe Temperature Protection
cause: Refrigerant shortage or closed valve
solution: Check refrigerant leaks and ensure valves are open.

title: Communication Error
cause: Communication error between indoor and outdoor units
solution: Check the transmission cable and connections.

title: Indoor/Outdoor Communication Error
cause: Time-out error due to disconnected or broken wires
solution: Inspect power and communication wiring.

title: High Pressure Lockout
cause: Dirty condenser coil or failed fan motor
solution: Clean condenser coil and verify fan operation.

title: Low Ambient Sensor Fault
cause: Sensor reading out of range or damaged wiring
solution: Measure sensor resistance and replace if faulty.

title: Return Air Thermistor Issue
cause: Short or open circuit in thermistor
solution: Replace the return air thermistor.

title: Indoor Unit PCB Defect
cause: Microcomputer failure or corrupted software on the indoor unit PCB
solution: Replace the indoor unit printed circuit board (PCB).

title: Indoor Fan Motor Overload/Lock
cause: Blocked fan blade, bad fan motor bearings, or loose motor wire connection
solution: Inspect fan motor, check for obstructions, and replace if defective.

title: Liquid Pipe Thermistor Error
cause: Faulty liquid pipe temperature sensor or disconnected harness
solution: Check thermistor resistance and reconnect or replace.

title: High Pressure Switch Actuated
cause: Dirty condenser coils, restricted airflow, or overcharged refrigerant
solution: Clean condenser coils, check system pressure, and ensure proper airflow.

title: Low Pressure Switch Actuated
cause: Low refrigerant charge, closed service valve, or restricted expansion device
solution: Check for refrigerant leaks and verify valve positions.

title: High Pressure Switch Defect
cause: Faulty high-pressure switch or loose wiring connection
solution: Test pressure switch continuity and replace if faulty.

title: Discharge Pipe Thermistor Error
cause: Faulty discharge pipe temperature sensor
solution: Replace the discharge thermistor.

title: Inverter Radiation Fin Overheating
cause: Blocked inverter cooling fins, failed inverter fan, or high ambient temperature
solution: Clean inverter cooling area and check cooling fan operation.

title: Inverter Compressor Temperature Sensor Fault
cause: Thermistor disconnected or out of range
solution: Check sensor connection and replace if necessary.

title: Refrigerant Shortage
cause: Refrigerant leak or restricted electronic expansion valve
solution: Perform leak check, repair, and recharge system to proper weight.

title: Indoor Return Air Sensor Error
cause: Open or short circuit in indoor ambient thermistor
solution: Check thermistor resistance and replace if out of spec.

title: Indoor Coil Sensor Error
cause: Open or short circuit in indoor coil thermistor
solution: Inspect coil sensor wiring and replace sensor.

title: Outdoor Coil Sensor Error
cause: Faulty outdoor coil temperature sensor
solution: Verify outdoor thermistor connection and replace.

title: Inverter Communication Error
cause: Communication breakdown between main board and inverter module
solution: Check wiring harnesses and control boards.

title: Discharge Temperature Too High
cause: Low refrigerant, high compression ratio, or faulty discharge sensor
solution: Check system superheat and refrigerant charge.

title: AC Input Overvoltage / Undervoltage
cause: Unstable power supply voltage to the unit
solution: Check incoming line voltage and site power stability.

title: Outdoor Fan Motor Fault
cause: Blocked outdoor fan or burned-out motor winding
solution: Test outdoor fan motor power and replace if failed.

title: Compressor Overcurrent Protection
cause: Stalled compressor, high discharge pressure, or inverter fault
solution: Check compressor winding resistance and system pressures.

title: EEPROM Error
cause: Data read/write failure on control board memory chip
solution: Re-flash control board or replace main PCB.

title: Outdoor Ambient Temperature Sensor Error
cause: Open or shorted outdoor ambient thermistor
solution: Replace outdoor ambient sensor.
